serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Fulcrum is a cloud manufacturing operations system for small and mid-sized discrete manufacturers, including CNC machine shops, sheet metal fabricators, and aerospace and defense suppliers. It combines ERP, MRP and manufacturing execution in one web application, from quoting and planning through scheduling, shop-floor tracking, quality, shipping and invoicing.

Archie, the AI built into Fulcrum, answers questions about a customer's live shop data, takes actions on it, and builds custom pages and tools. Customers can also connect their own AI assistants to the same data tools through the Fulcrum MCP server, within each user's permissions. Archie's AI models are hosted in Microsoft Azure Government with the rest of the offering, so prompts to Archie and the shop data it reads stay in Azure Government; a customer's own assistant runs wherever the customer chooses.

Customers reach the service through a web browser, a REST API and MCP.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Fulcrum's FedRAMP certification data: a program overview, and Fulcrum's published positions on the FedRAMP rules and Key Security Indicators that apply to the offering.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Go to https://trust.fulcrumpro.us and choose "Government agencies and assessors". Enter your work email address and sign in with the one-time passcode sent to it. Some organizations are given access when their members first sign in. For any other address, the sign-in is recorded as a request for access: Fulcrum responds to requests from government addresses within 5 business days, and contacts other requesters about their request. Fulcrum staff choose "Fulcrum staff".

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: The Secure Configuration Guide for the offering. It is not published and is not stored in the Trust Center; it is sent by email on request.
secureConfigurationGuidance.accessRequestInstructions: The guide is supplied on request to agencies, assessors and customers. Sign in to the Fulcrum Trust Center as described above, then email fedramp-security@fulcrumpro.com naming your organization. Fulcrum answers requests from government addresses within 5 business days.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: The AI built into Fulcrum. It answers questions about live shop data, takes actions on it, and builds custom pages and tools.
The Fulcrum MCP server, which connects a customer's own AI assistant to Archie's data tools within the user's permissions, and the Fulcrum REST API.
Quality management for AS9100D and ISO 9001 shops: drawing bubbling, in-process inspection, nonconformances, corrective actions and calibration.
Nests generated from DXF files on quotes, nest planning across orders, and grouping of operations across jobs into shared work.
Quotes with material and labor pricing and capacity-based lead times, converted into sales orders.
Multi-level bills of materials and operation routings for every made part.
Material requirements from open demand, with draft purchase orders grouped by vendor.
Automated production scheduling across machines and labor, re-optimized as priorities change.
Shop-floor kiosks where operators clock labor, pick material and record progress on each operation.
Live inventory by location, with lot and certification tracking.
Receiving against purchase orders, shipments against sales orders, and packing documents.
Live job costs from actual labor, machine time and material, compared with estimates.
Live production, inventory, quality and shop-floor reports.

excludedServices.serviceDescription: Connections to accounting, shipping and other outside systems, including webhooks and chat alerts.
A portal where a manufacturer's own customers view orders and documents.
Drag-and-drop custom reports, scheduled report exports and the executive dashboard.
Fulcrum actions from inside Microsoft Outlook.
Conversion of native CAD formats for in-browser viewing through a third-party service.
Creating bills of materials, parts and nests from uploaded drawings, PDFs and nest sheets with AI.

Automatic drawing bubbling in Control; Archie web search, help-article search and code execution; the inspection, inventory continuity, job log and work-in-progress report downloads and grid column export; and these REST API operations: purchase order PDF, calibration certificate and scrap report downloads, single nonconformance and corrective action reads, item can-make and purchase history reads, item customer, item tag and material vendor changes, department, equipment and work center changes, in-process tracking lists, completing an item-to-make operation, and material lookup.

documentationOverview: Fulcrum keeps its FedRAMP certification data in the Fulcrum Trust Center, which government agencies and assessors can sign in to as described below. The Secure Configuration Guide, which explains how customers configure the offering securely, is supplied on request.
